purpose: Take an observed missing executable-organ interface plus one explicit human/AI/recipe-supplied organ proposal, materialize and test it through the detached Forge, then prove or hold its exact contribution through an ephemeral discovery and full assembly build without installing it.

properties.path: detached candidate directory under creations/ or outside the live machine body
properties.organ_goal: exact axm.interface-organ-goal/v0.1 object that currently emits HOLD_MISSING_ORGAN_INTERFACE
properties.proposal: one explicit closed axm.creation-unit-spawn-proposal/v0.1 organ design whose entrypoint is a complete executable-organ package
properties.checks: optional deterministic checks applied to the ephemeral full closure project
properties.replace: optional boolean allowing explicit replacement of the detached candidate directory

contains: detached Forge materialization and test evidence
READY or typed HOLD closure discovery
ephemeral full assembly build receipt when READY

relationships: starts only from a presently observed missing executable-organ interface
accepts supplied source rather than claiming the deterministic kernel invented semantic implementation
requires exact equality between Forge unit provides/requires and executable-organ package declarations
materializes and tests the candidate through the continuing detached Creation-Unit Forge
makes the candidate visible only in a disposable exact library overlay together with installed package sources
re-runs the original interface goal and requires the candidate exact ref to participate in the selected READY closure
builds the complete closure in disposable validated project space before reporting success
keeps test success, admission request, approval, installation, registration, promotion, merge, and CANON distinct

anatomy_refs.basis: The experiment binds an observed missing exact interface contract to one supplied package declaration, then proves whether the same goal becomes an exact complete closure.
Candidate source is materialized and tested through the existing detached Creation-Unit Forge rather than copied into the live package body.
The operation is a fixed evidence recipe: missing contract, supplied organ, Forge test, overlay discovery, exact resolution, and disposable validated assembly.

limitations: the candidate organ design and source must be explicitly supplied by a human, AI, deterministic recipe, or labeled external boundary
a candidate that passes package validation and one closure build is not proven semantically correct for every future use
declared interface names remain structural contracts and source-level conformance is not proven
the ephemeral project validates files and caller checks but does not execute generated runtime behavior or judge visual quality
the candidate remains detached and is not installed into executable-organs/ or admitted by this operation
candidate ref collisions, proposal/package contract drift, unrelated proposals, failed Forge tests, incomplete closure, and failed builds remain typed HOLDs
persistent_state: only the caller-selected detached Forge candidate persists; overlays and closure projects are disposed after each experiment

truth.basis: The initial gap, supplied source, exact contract alignment, candidate test, overlay contents, final selection, build receipt, and proof limits remain distinct and inspectable.

agency.basis: Humans and AIs may supply different implementations, while ambiguity and failure HOLD and the experiment grants itself no admission or installation authority.

continuity.basis: The live executable-organ library remains unchanged; the tested candidate persists only in its detached package until a separate choice.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: A new organ must align with the observed gap, pass the existing Forge, become necessary in exact re-discovery, and complete a validated assembly before the closure claim is emitted.
